collections.title: Bathtub, Bathroom and Shower Grab Bars

description.html: Statistics repeatedly show that slips and falls in the bathtub are one of the most common causes of serious injury in the elderly and those with mobility issues. Getting in and out of a slippery bathtub can be difficult even when mobility isn't an issue. That's why installing a shower or bathtub grab bar, or floor to ceiling transfer pole is one of the most important safety enhancements to any bathroom. Grab bars for bathrooms are attached strategically to walls in the tub and shower area to offer a steadying brace to hold onto while getting in and out of the bath and when standing in the shower. It's one of the most helpful bathroom accessories used by those who live alone and want to maintain their independence as well as caregivers taking care of loved ones. Our selection of bathroom grab bars comes in a range of sizes, styles and finishes to best fit your needs and complement your bathroom decor. Choose from bathtub handles to shower knobs to safety rails. We have styles that can be affixed permanently as well as ones that can be removed when not in use. Non-wearing rubber pads ensure the product will not scratch your tub's surface. Easy and quick to install, many removable bars require tool-free installation. Specialized features such as textured gripping surfaces, adjustable heights and dual level designs for high-low support offer further protection from falls. With such trusted brands as Carex, Stander, Complete Medical and Drive Medical filling our inventory, you'll have peace of mind knowing that whichever one you select, it'll be durably made to offer exceptional stability. If needed, we also offer toilet handles and bars to facilitate getting up and down from the toilet, to further lower your risk of a fall in the bathroom. Whether you're shopping for yourself or a loved one, help to create the safest bathing environment possible with our quality selection of bathroom bars and railings. For bedroom safety, check out our grab bars for beds.

description.html: Features: Provides additional stability when entering and exiting the tub or shower. Easy to install or remove with locking latches that secure the grab bar into place. description.html: Adult Bed Rails are a great support tool for when getting in and out of bed is a challenge. Often family caregivers call us looking for support structures like hospital beds, when in reality, a good bed rail can serve a similar purpose at a fraction of the cost. A lack of upper body strength, poor mobility and balance issues are some factors that can make this activity of daily living difficult and even painful. One of the simplest yet most effective solutions is a supportive bed rail. Quickly installed, a rail offers one or more easily accessible grasping points to ease lying down and standing up from bed and adjusting position while in bed. For those looking for a little help without a large footprint in the bedroom, these bed rails and bed rails assist fit that "small footprint" category.
